    AI Overview
    The 2026 Nebraska Football Spring Game took place on Saturday, March 28, 2026, at Memorial Stadium, with the Red Team defeating the White Team 22-17. The scrimmage featured newcomers such as quarterback Anthony Colandrea and was highlighted by a "quiet and focused" atmosphere as summarized by head coach Matt Rhule. 
    Key 2026 Spring Game Details: 
    • Final Score: Red Team 22, White Team 17.
    • Date: March 28, 2026.
    • Location: Memorial Stadium, Lincoln, Nebraska.
    • Key Performers: Quarterback Anthony Colandrea (Red Team) made his debut.
    • Format: Standard scoring with 15-minute quarters and a running clock.
    • Notable Absence: Defensive lineman Anthony Jones missed the game to be with his newborn, according to the Omaha World-Herald. 
    Information is based on reports from March 28, 2026, from sources including KOLN | Nebraska Local News, Weather, Sports | Lincoln, NE, huskers.com, and YouTube channels covering the team.
